content.rationale: Closing a bracket is where S5-marker-append's kept entry ids appended in run order — with the undone tail discarded and the position set to the end — S5-ordered's order-visibility, and the corpus documents owned by S5-corpus (ylroyrvu) — named here, not claimed — meet; this check drives append over scratch roots and pins that a fresh root's first append lands the appended document exactly, that a further marker lands last in file order, that the undone tail is discarded and the position is set to the end, that a fresh marker records no reverts of its own, that an append leaves the marker file and no temporary, and that a file that does not parse — or parses but does not conform to the schema — is refused with the reason carried. It pulls in serde_json and the validator the persist crate needs, so it is a crate of its own; the JSON layer is I1-serde's and the validator I1-schema's.
